summary: Phase 5 FR-14 acceptance passes after live verification. IM3 lib/auth/server.ts composes @math-platform/core-auth request guards, preserves the stricter credential.isActive === true check, the IM3 auth suite is green (61/61), the FR-14 tech-debt row is Resolved, and the Phase 5 UMV task was marked complete in plan.md. During acceptance the FR-3 JSDoc guard invariant initially failed on two legitimate prose-brace false positives; the guard was fixed in commit 3bbced05 and now passes while still failing the malformed stray-block fixture.
nonblocking_findings: PROJECT_LINT (`npm run lint`) currently fails on two pre-existing warnings in apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/onboarding/student-flow.test.ts; these are unrelated to Phase 5 auth files and were already called out in Phase 5 evidence.

PROJECT_CHECKS (`npx tsc --noEmit`) fails at the repo root with TS18003 because the root tsconfig has an empty include list; `npm run ws:im3:typecheck` also reports many pre-existing/problemFamilyId-to-variantKey drift errors unrelated to Phase 5 auth composition.
PROJECT_TESTS (`npm run test`) passes for the configured root project test gate (packages/knowledge-space-core: 285/285).
evidence: Read measure/index.md, measure/tracks.md, track spec.md, plan.md Phase 5, test-strategy.md Phase 5, tech-debt.md, lessons-learned.md, Phase 5/7/8 review artifacts, IM3 auth server/tests, BM2 auth server, and core-auth request-guards.

apps/integrated-math-3/lib/auth/server.ts imports and delegates to core-auth getRequestSessionClaims, requireRequestSessionClaims, requireRoleRequestClaims, and requireActiveRequestSessionClaims; it no longer redeclares getCookieValueFromHeader or inline 401/403/503 builders.
IM3 verifyActiveCredential returns credential !== null && credential.isActive === true, preserving the stricter IM3 behavior required by test-strategy.md §38.
measure/tech-debt.md row 'IM3 auth wrapper inline duplication' is Status: Resolved.

No A3/A4/A5/A6/A7 blockers found in the current Phase 5 evidence; prior review artifacts' PASS claims matched rerun auth tests. The only live invariant failure was the FR-3 guard false positive, now fixed.
